title: Web service depends Wifi connection
body:
Hello, 
Big thanks to developer(s) which make xDrip+ possible. 
I plan to enhance my CGM setup (Libre+Blucon+xDrip) using a Fitbit watch (Versa).
I am currently testing xDrip Web Service data availability on http://127.0.0.1:17580/sgv.json end point.
The Web service provides a '_Temporary unavailable or under maintenance_' error page if my Android phone  (A5 2017) is not connected to any Wifi network.
I would like to know if :
- this is normal and is a prerequisite,
- it should work without any wifi connection and how make this possible.

Many thanks for your reply and your time,
Simon.

comments.body:
@jamorham I've been emailing back and forward with @MrSiimon and was wondering if you had any input on this? 

Hes settings from what hes showed me look right.

But when he turns off WiFi on the phone it won't show the endpoints data. 

Any idea?

Just wifi or is it mobile data and wifi are disabled? I've tested here manually on Sony Z5C (android 6.x) and as expected the local webservice still responds to queries when both wifi and mobile data are disabled (and various combinations)

Could this be a fitbit companion app issue that it detects the lack of connectivity and _helpfully_ refuses to initiate any outbound connections?

Hello, 
Thank you for your reply. 
Actually browser behavior made me wrong, cause returns a _webservice unavailable page_ when wifi (and optionally) data is off. On a reload/refresh, browser identifies that phone is offline. Using http request tool, the web service still  responds. 

You are also right it seems that Fitbit companion apps requires an internet connection to initiate any connection. 

Finally the connectivity looks hazardous between fitbit and external webservice. For now I give up this way for watch integration.

Thanks for help.
